name: codex-workflow
description: Hook-driven workflow orchestration plugin for Codex with CLI workers, resume support, cost tracking, and structured logs.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel workflow orchestration for Codex with hooks, resume, and review gates.
interface.longDescription: Codex Workflow turns Codex into a configurable workflow runner with route-based executor selection, hook-driven dispatch rules, resumable batches, structured logs, and estimated token cost summaries.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codex Workflow for my project and explain the first batch run.
Show me how to route architect tasks to Codex and implementers to CLI workers.
Help me create a custom workflow preset with hook rules and review gates.
